canon.silhouette: top-heavy anvil: a broad canopy overhangs a narrower trailing skirt — the inverse of the ground-hugging dome profile shared by all nine brood walker variants, so it reads apart by outline alone at horde scale in a 56px cell
canon.reads_as: an elite that punishes clumped retinues (GDD §7 swarm-punishing elite, the soft cost backing retinue upkeep): the canopy visibly flares wider before its area burst, so a massed army reads the telegraph and spreads

prompt.description: Heavy amorphous mass of glistening near-black tar (#211e20) moving on four blunt pseudopod limbs. The body rises into a broad overhanging canopy, wider than its base, like a wet anvil or a storm-bent fungus cap, with a ragged skirt of dripping tendrils trailing beneath. Steel-grey (#555568) undertones sit in the folds; a single matte pale (#e9efec) mark sits at the crown of the canopy, catching light only, never emitting it. No face, no eyes, no symmetry — torn-membrane surface texture. The bulk rides high and top-heavy, silhouette flaring outward at the top.
must_include: overhanging canopy wider than its base
single matte pale crown mark, non-luminous
dripping tendril skirt under the canopy
near-black body with steel-grey fold tones
must_avoid: glow, self-illumination, or light emission of any kind
